name: go-architecture-review
description: > Review Go project architecture: package structure, dependency direction, layering, separation of concerns, domain modeling, and module boundaries. Use when reviewing architecture, designing package layout, evaluating dependency graphs, or refactoring monoliths into modules. Trigger examples: "review architecture", "package structure", "project layout", "dependency direction", "clean architecture Go", "module boundaries". Do NOT use for code-level style (use go-coding-standards) or API endpoint
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 用于审查和设计 Go 项目架构，适合优化包结构、依赖方向、分层与模块边界，以及将单体应用重构为模块。
